name: coordination/refusal-forbidden-surface
description: Any admin op arriving on coord.sock (including `stage_consent`) and any worker op arriving there: the RFC 9457 body is exactly {type, title, status, detail} in that order. The detail names the surface and nothing else — a refusal must not tell a coordination driver which ops exist elsewhere. Deny-by-absence: the op is not merely unauthorized, it is unaddressable from here.

problem.title: operation not permitted on this local surface
problem.detail: the coordination surface cannot perform this operation

expected.body: {"type":"urn:akson:error:forbidden-surface","title":"operation not permitted on this local surface","status":403,"detail":"the coordination surface cannot perform this operation"}
